note: Renders are scratchpad/w14 (m01-m19) and w14q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from 2c1eb9d (includes 74e228b). They are compared with w13/w13q. The q01, q11 and q19 cameras differ from w13q: q11 now looks straight at the bar face, like samchui_render_11, and q19 looks down the rear galley. Most w13 carry-overs are now fixed in the renders: the galley frames, rivets and cart posts, the smooth pots, the welcome cabinet size and position, the separated neutral ash-wall flaps, the flight-deck kick panel, jamb and lock, the J/PY and door-2 curtains, the bar rail and tumblers, and the arc hue. Remaining: the welcome cabinet pane is plum and reads as open shelving rather than smoked glass. The F/J curtain (curtainF, not curtainC) is still warm brown in m07. The ash-wall frames are flat strokes with square-looking corners. The lav and bar ash grain is still coarse and streaky. Lighting is noted but not scored: the q19 galley walls and ceiling blow out to near white, and the m09/m01 upper compartments are fogged. Sampling: python3 + PIL mean / p10 / p90 (by luminance) over boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1). Script: scratchpad/raterB14/s.py. w13-vs-w14 pairs: scratchpad/raterB14/p_*.png.

details.note: No more fence. The tumblers have rims and the bottles have highlights. The layout, blind, screen, fridge and stile tone match samchui_render_11: q11 stile #8d816e against #877969, door ash #c1b49a against #bfb098. Two differences remain. The ash is streakier (std 9.6 against 6.6), and the counter top is a dark slab over a grey rail rather than wrapped in a bright aluminium band.

The cabinet width, abutment, top line, deep top rail and latch bulge now match omaat_room_32. The pane interior is plum-mauve (#433a3d, G < B) and fully legible, so it reads as an open shelf with a tinted back rather than smoked glass. The photo pane is neutral #2e2c2b, and its contents are dim.

The flaps are separate on their own panels and the frames are neutral, so the main mismatch is gone. The frames are flat strokes with no relief or highlight, the latch is a flat red tab, and the ash is horizontally banded.

Unchanged. The ash lav doors are coarse and smeared (m17 std 12), and the q11 side lav faces show the same streaks.

The J/PY curtain is now cool slate (#3e404b). The monitors, pockets and PY aft navy curtain are right. The bassinet bar remains.
The pots are smooth and polished, the inserts framed and riveted, and the copper latches right. The upper compartment fog is lighting.
The carts carry riveted posts and tags, and the inserts are framed. The q19 white-out is lighting, not scored.

details.detail: Standard galley inserts (m01, m09, m12, q19)

The J/PY, door-2, PY (navy) and rear (light grey) curtains are right. The F/J curtain (curtainF) is still warm brown in m07.

issues.detail: Welcome galley glass cabinet pane (m03, m16)
issues.problem: The proportion is fixed, but the interior back is plum-mauve and every shelf and box reads crisply, with no smoked-glass cue. In m16, a large area, it reads as an open purple shelf unit.
issues.evidence: m03 pane (500,200,680,420) #433a3d (G 0x3a < B 0x3d), p90 #575152. omaat_room_32 pane (760,200,900,380) #2e2c2b (neutral), with contents visibly dimmed. m16 interior (530,200,760,520) is plum throughout.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley: back '#5c5052' -> '#4c4948', shelves '#7a6f71' -> '#6a6766', box colours x0.85, and add a 0.006-wide diagonal bead-tone streak pair (gQuad, MONMAT bead, low e) across the upper pane as a reflection cue. Keep the no-full-pane rule.

issues.problem: The F/J aisle curtains use MONMAT.curtainF ('#57504a'), which the w13b fix did not change, so they still render warm brown. omaat_room_36 shows this same curtain from the J side as cool charcoal.
issues.fix: MONMAT.curtainF '#57504a' -> '#55555c' (between the omaatF_2 warm-light and omaat_room_36 samples), or use curtainC for the F/J gap as well.

issues.problem: The frames read as flat, coplanar 3 cm grey strokes: no relief or highlight, the corners look square, and the latch is a flat red tab. In lalf_133 they are proud, polished frames with rounded corners and a red clip on a chrome stem.
issues.evidence: m04 frame (118,250,128,500) #c8beab, std 12.7, with no edge highlight. lalf_133 frame (22,560,40,860) shows a bright lit edge and a shadowed inner edge.
issues.fix: In buildAshWall: frame depth 0.012 -> 0.02 and radius 0.03 -> 0.05; inner flap inset to 0.008 behind the frame face; flapFrame r 0.32 -> 0.22 for a highlight; add a 0.012 alu stem under the red tab.

issues.detail: Galley insert frames low contrast (m09, m01, m12)
issues.problem: The frames and rivets exist, but they are within about 3 % of the face tone, so at 930 px the inserts still read nearly frameless. In sansY_44 the frames are darker and more metallic than the faces.
issues.evidence: m09 frame column (140,10,152,200) #afaeab against face (160,240,300,380) #7a7873 lower / about #a8a7a5 upper. In sansY_44 the frames (400,60,425,180) read #4f473c against the faces (280,20,410,180) #675d4a, about 0.75x.
issues.fix: In aluFrame: use a frame material about 0.8x the face ('#8e8d89', r 0.35, m 0.5) instead of 'a touch brighter'. No triangle change.

issues.problem: The counter top is a dark overhanging slab with a separate grey rail below it. samchui_render_11 has a bright aluminium band wrapping the top edge, flush with the deck.
issues.fix: In buildBar: replace the front rail and nosing with one 0.035-tall alu (MONMAT.alu) band on the counter front edge, flush with the top.

issues.fix: Halve the fabric/wood layer gain for barAsh and the lav door material, or tile the ash at about 2x the frequency.
